name: Greene Metropolitan Housing Authority
description: The public housing authority: public housing, and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8) that help pay rent.
eligibility: Based on income and household size.

steps: Call 937-376-2908 to ask if the waiting list is open.
Ask how to get on the list, and what to bring.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: Waiting lists can be long, and they open and close. Ask when this one will open if it is closed.
